challenged_statement: There is a universal c>0 such that every symmetric zero-diagonal H with s2(H)>tau has a coordinate cut whose cross block C satisfies s2(C)>=c tau.
counterexample: Take A=[[0,1,1,1],[1,2,0,0],[1,0,2,0],[1,0,0,2]] and H=A-diag(A). The target matrix A has spectrum {-1,2,2,3}; H is a three-leaf star with singular values sqrt(3),sqrt(3),0,0, but every coordinate cut cross block has rank one, hence s2(C)=0.
scope_warning: This is not a counterexample to the full QFORM conjecture; the example is already paid by same-sign physical diagonals. It refutes only the stronger rank-two-cut extraction shortcut and shows near-rank-one grouped-bank/localized branches are necessary.
replacement: Use the Ky-Fan random-cut trichotomy: some cut has s1(C)+s2(C)>tau/2, then either a quantitative two-channel resource appears or a near-rank-one diffuse/localized mechanism must be paid.
